audit_target: The /e2e-automation field survey published on frankbueltge.de
provenance: The eight primary sources listed in the survey component (src/components/pages/E2EAutomationPage.astro, the `sources` array) on frankbueltge.de, transcribed verbatim 2026-07-24 — cited_as strings and cited_url are exactly as they appear on the page; the identifier (arxiv id / doi) is parsed from each cited_url. No entry is invented. The survey is itself the public rendering of a 106-agent research run, and its own subject is that AI research systems fabricate citations (a documented 40-80% field gap); auditing the survey's own citations is therefore the reflexive first use of N2 — a survey that warns of citation fabrication must itself survive its citations being checked.
note_on_titles: The page cites by descriptive label + URL, not by paper title, so most citations carry no independently claimed_title to match against — the audit's primary verdict for this target is EXISTENCE (does the cited identifier resolve to a real registered work). claimed_title is set only where the citer's own label IS the work's title prefix; it is never back-filled from the resolved title (that would be circular).
